questions.text:
Write an essay on at least ONE visual or oral text that you have studied, in response to ONE of the statements below. Discuss the extent to which you agree with your chosen statement. Respond critically to the statement by making a close analysis of the text(s).

STATEMENTS (Choose ONE):
1. In effective texts, vision and sound work together to challenge the viewer's understanding.
2. Heroes give us hope through the way they manage their own weaknesses.
3. The way characters interact with their environment reveals important truths.
4. In a great text there is a turning point that disrupts the viewer's expectations.
5. Differences between settings reveal significant ideas about our world.
6. Successful texts deliver important ideas that help us to examine ourselves.
7. Unusual relationships shape the audience's understanding of everyday life.
8. The characters who influence us the most are those who make us uncomfortable.

You should aim to write a concise essay of no more than 5-6 pages in length. The quality of your writing is more important than the length of your essay.
questions.markingGuide:
ACHIEVEMENT (3-4 marks): Present a structured response following essay conventions (some clumsiness in style/organisation allowed). Develop a relevant critical argument that provides an evaluative response to the chosen statement, showing engagement with the text(s). Make and evaluate a range of relevant points showing understanding of the aspect(s) specified in the statement. Include specific and relevant details from the text(s) to support the argument. For visual/oral texts, reference specific techniques such as camera angles, lighting, sound design, mise-en-scene, dialogue, or performance.

MERIT (5-6 marks): Present a structured response following essay conventions. Develop a convincing critical argument showing familiarity and engagement with the text(s). Make and evaluate relevant points showing convincing understanding of the aspect(s) specified. Begin to weave specific details from the text(s) into the response to effectively support the argument. Potentially link the argument to matters beyond the text(s). Demonstrate understanding of how visual/oral techniques create meaning.

EXCELLENCE (7-8 marks): Present a cohesive and articulate response following essay conventions, showing some originality of expression. Develop a sophisticated and insightful or original critical argument showing familiarity with and appreciation of the text(s). Make and evaluate relevant points showing perceptive understanding of the aspect(s) specified. Weave specific and judiciously chosen relevant details from the text(s) into the response to effectively support and expand the argument. Link the argument to other aspects of the text or other contexts such as human experience, society, and the wider world.
